answer: A bond is refunded only after 15 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The beacon counter is kept in shale and nectar exposes each reset. An adversary hence has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 15 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4615 identities would post 1768 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
